shortDescription: British retailer WH Smith LSE:SMWH said on Wednesday it expects annual pre-tax profit of about £75 million ($101.1 million), at the bottom end of its earlier forecast range, as margins were crimped by higher promotional activity and costs.($1 = 0.7418 pounds)
